Notes:
     DT(s)          : Correction to the Earth's clock in seconds.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The above data has been generated using the polynomial coefficients 
that represent the spline approximation (v 2020, Table-S15.2020.txt)
discussed by L.V. Morrison, F.R. Stephenson, C.Y. Hohenkerk and 
M. Zawilski, in their paper entitled ``Addendum 2020 to `Measurement of 
the  Earth's Rotation: 720 BC to AD 2015'' published in the Royal Society 
Proceedings A, 478, 2021, see https://doi.org/10.1098/rspa.2020.0776.  
For those dates outside the range of the approximation, the values have
been calculated by extrapolation.

Details of the original analysis is published in Royal Society 
Proceedings A, 472, 2016, at https://doi.org/10.1098/rspa.2016.0404
